method: Independently rehashed the ZIP against GitHub artifact metadata and compared all five member bodies against the extracted files and archive manifest.
Parsed all six controls.log lines and checked exact equality with the six token-result cases.
Verified the before/after source and driver bindings, source hashes including the Git LF versus Windows checkout CRLF distinction, original one-attempt counts and all cleanup fields.
Recomputed the four complete and two incomplete controls and checked the original child return code 1 with no timeout or stderr.
findings: Both no-reader cases and both separately released-reader cases replace successfully. Both held-reader cases fail the original replacement while the real reader handle is still open.
Each of the six fresh cases makes one writer call and one replace call under the original lock; all reader/writer threads, handles, temporary siblings and fixture directories are cleaned up.
The two held-reader failures are PermissionError errno 13, WinError 5. Their old contents remain readable, and the original exception is retained by the fixture.
The original strict WinError 32 expectation is not met: both held-reader controls and the combined report remain incomplete, and the declared control step fails.

The symmetric result demonstrates a reader/replacement compatibility gap for the exact controlled overlap. It does not reproduce or attribute the normal 8f failed-job WinError 32 handle, and it does not resolve the separate command-mutation private-open error.

The retained job metadata was still in post-job cleanup at the time of this peer; the completed control step, child exit and artifacts are independently verified without promoting the entire run to terminal success.
